name: Mukhyamantri Seekho-Kamao Yojana (MMSKY)
ministry_or_dept: Department of Technical Education, Skill Development & Employment, MP
target_audience: 12th Pass, ITI, Diploma & B.Tech / Graduate youth resident in Madhya Pradesh (Age 18-29)
description: Flagship Madhya Pradesh initiative providing on-the-job training in 703 industrial courses across 46 sectors. State government directly transfers 75% of the stipend to the candidate's Aadhaar-linked bank account (DBT).
benefits: ₹8,000/mo for 12th pass, ₹8,500/mo for ITI, ₹9,000/mo for Diploma, and ₹10,000/mo for Graduates/Engineers
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into trainee bank account
State-recognized State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT) certification
High probability of permanent absorption in partner enterprise

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Govt of India
target_audience: Engineers, Diploma holders, and Vocational graduates across India
description: National program reimbursing 25% of prescribed stipend directly to candidates engaged in designated tech & engineering apprenticeship trades with public & private enterprises.
benefits: Statutory apprenticeship certificate from Government of India
Real-world industrial exposure in leading PSUs and technology corporations

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
target_audience: Indian youth seeking industry 4.0 technical skills (AI, Cloud, IoT, Robotics)
description: Covers Industry 4.0 on-demand training tracks in emerging technologies with zero tuition fee and government assessment certification.
benefits: 100% sponsored government credential verified on Skill India Digital
National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF) level 5-7 alignment
Placement assistance across NSDC partner job fairs (Rozgar Melas)

name: Digital India Internship Scheme
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
target_audience: B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA students with minimum 60% marks in previous examinations
description: Two-month summer/winter internship program providing exposure to public digital public infrastructure projects (DigiLocker, UPI, Aadhaar, e-Sign, and Open Government Data).
benefits: Mentorship under senior scientists & e-governance directors at MeitY
Certificate of Internship from Government of India
Valuable credential for campus placements and public policy tech careers

name: AICTE Free Virtual Internship & NEAT Mission
ministry_or_dept: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
target_audience: All AICTE-affiliated college engineering and technical students
description: Collaborative programs with Google, AWS, Salesforce, and Cisco providing verified project cohorts directly credited to university academic transcripts under NEP 2020.
benefits: Automatic NEP 2020 credit transfer directly recognized by affiliated universities
Industry certificates verified on digital locker
Access to enterprise developer cloud sandbox credits

name: MP Startup Policy & Student Innovation Seed Fund
target_audience: Student founders and innovators in MP universities and incubation centers
description: Financial assistance, lease rental reimbursement, and innovation grants for engineering students commercializing technical prototypes or SaaS solutions.
benefits: Monthly sustenance allowance of ₹10,000 for verified student innovators
Prototyping grant up to ₹5,00,000 and seed equity matching
Incubation support at Atal Incubation Centres across Bhopal and Indore
